title: Toddler Girl Walking Barefoot Outside Suburban Home, 1961 Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a toddler girl walking barefoot along a sunny concrete sidewalk. She is wearing a striped, pleated sun suit with a bow at the neckline. The background features post-war mid-century suburban brick houses with wrought-iron decorative porch posts, concrete steps, and house number 3081 prominently displayed beside the screen door.
